workflow: A serialization operation obtains a temporary view into a mutable buffer and validates its layout.
Before consuming the view, it invokes user-controlled callback logic that releases or invalidates the underlying buffer.
The operation continues using the previously obtained pointer and length without retaining or revalidating the backing storage.
Access through the stale view reaches released memory, causing a use-after-free instead of safe serialization.
summary: Reentrant callback invalidates buffer before deferred view use
